request.style: English, Male baritone solo with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, flute, warm reverberant atmosphere, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From the tribe of Dan he came
Son of Ahisamach by name
Appointed to work with Bezalel
To build God's dwelling, to fulfill the goal
I have given skill to every craftsman
So they can make what I have planned

[Chorus]
Oholiab, son of Ahisamach
Of the tribe of Dan, a skilled touch
Engravers, designers, weavers too
Blue and purple, crimson hue
Masters of every craft and art
Creating what is in God's heart

[Verse]
The ability to teach others well
To help them build, to help them tell
All the work of the sanctuary
According to the command of the Lord
Moses called the skilled craftsmen
To carry out the sacred plan

[Chorus]
Oholiab, son of Ahisamach
Of the tribe of Dan, a skilled touch
Engravers, designers, weavers too
Blue and purple, crimson hue
Masters of every craft and art
Creating what is in God's heart

[Bridge]
Wisdom and understanding filled their hands
To know how to carry out the plans
Just as the LORD had commanded
Every fabric, every thread

[Chorus]
Oholiab, son of Ahisamach
Of the tribe of Dan, a skilled touch
Engravers, designers, weavers too
Blue and purple, crimson hue
Masters of every craft and art
Creating what is in God's heart

[Outro]
The tabernacle stands complete
A work of faith, a holy seat
